headline: Meta funds research at five universities
dek: The package pairs funding, model access and Meta researchers, per Meta.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: Academic partnerships expand
body: Meta announced partnerships with Caltech, Ohio State, LSU, Indiana University and UTHealth Houston, per the company.
The package includes model access, funding and collaboration with Meta researchers, the company says.

points.t: Computer vision to monitor infants with tracheostomies.
Multimodal AI for conversations with dementia patients.
A model to predict heart failure risk.

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Money and gaps
body: Meta says it will grant $2 million across the five schools.
The company did not detail how the money splits across projects or give a timeline for results.

items.t: Researchers use Meta models, such as SAM.
Meta scientists collaborate with the teams.
Medicine, physics, chemistry, biology and more.

caption.hook: Meta announced university research funding: partnerships with five US schools and $2 million in total.
body: Per Meta, the package combines model access, funding and collaboration with company researchers. Caltech, Ohio State, LSU, Indiana University and UTHealth Houston are taking part, with a focus on medicine, physics, chemistry and other fields.

Projects named include an LSU computer-vision system to monitor infants with tracheostomies, Indiana AI for conversations with dementia patients and an Ohio State model to predict heart failure. Meta did not detail how the money splits or give a timeline for results.
